xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: SEBI show cause notice dated October 11, 2024, Settlement email dated October 17, 2025 and Settlement order dated December 17, 2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav:
As per show cause notice dated October 11, 2024, Non-compliances were observed at the time of inspection conducted by SEBI during the financial year 2023–24.
Further, as per the SEBI’s advice to adhere to the non monetary terms, a sum of ₹15,57,60,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Crore Fifty Seven Lakh Sixty Thousand), was paid by the Company within the stipulated timeframe.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no material impact on the financial, operation or other activities of the Company in lieu of the settlement application.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Service Tax demand in respect of Depository Participant Service. Filled an appeal with Supreme Court against the order issued by the Central Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The case was last listed on March 6, 2025, before the Bench of Hon’ble Chief Justice Sanjiv Khanna. The matter now stands adjourned, and no further hearing date has been notified by the Court yet.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Our tax consultants attended the personal hearing on March 27, 2025, where the Commissioner (Appeals-II), CGST & CX acknowledged our submissions and responses.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: We are currently preparing and filing an appeal before the GST Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT).
